item.title: Week 13 of Pregnancy
item.description: At 13 weeks, your body has begun to adjust to being pregnant, and many of the early discomforts are likely fading away. With renewed energy, you’re stepping into the second trimester—a period often considered the most enjoyable part of pregnancy. Your baby has now grown to about 7 centimeters in length and weighs approximately 30 grams.
